start.content: I have watched your investigation board grow. You have evidence that changes conclusions and evidence you are keeping out of affection. Can you tell the difference yet?

choices.text: What does the weightiest evidence carry?
What have the pages told you?

weight.content: The evidence with the most weight is the one that refuses to be explained away. A weighty piece of evidence is not the most dramatic — it is the one that generates the fewest alternative explanations.

pages.content: The pages tell me that the most dangerous thing about this man was not the healings. It was the categories He would not fit. Every questioner came with a trap. Every trap shattered on contact with the truth.

closing.content: Keep gathering. The board grows, but the truth is already there. You just have to be willing to see it.
